app.name: Resolvara P0 spike
app.short_description: Feasibility checks for the Resolvara AI-agent resolution audit.
app.long_description: Internal spike. Runs read-only checks (plus an optional, manually triggered test-ticket seeder) to learn what the Zendesk Apps Framework iframe and the Zendesk API allow. Nothing is sent outside the Zendesk account.
app.installation_instructions: Private test app. Install only in a sandbox or trial account.
